entities.summary: Tomislav Dretar is a Croatian, Bosnian, French and Belgian poet, writer, critic, and translator, as well as an academic, journalist, editor, political leader and president of Bihać's Croatian Defence Council during the Bosnian War. He is also known by the French alias Thomas Dretart.
